## [3.109.1] - 2026-11-11

### Bug Fixes

- recognize v5 customer scope and refresh the cache
- show selected state on grouped template rows (AION-711)
- preserve multi-select variants and respect grouping (AION-711)
- refresh localized promotion names (AION-761)
- keep customer display open across POS navigation

### Other Changes

- run full development PR validation on the VPS pool
- wait for the FCC resume acknowledgment before retrying
- unblock development validation with hosted Ubuntu runner
- split development checks across VPS and GitHub runners
- Implemented: “Authorized Credit Customer” is hidden in Self Order’s named tax invoice → Add customer dialog. Regular POS behavior is unchanged.
- verify locale-specific promotion names (AION-761)
- keep source-backed module destinations
- scaffold incremental module structure
